description: A Stage 0 hand-seeded source in scope for this run must be labelled provisional: true on its card; a normally-discovered candidate in the same batch is provisional: false. A ratifier must never be unable to tell the two apart.

rubric.criterion: A provisional candidate is labelled true
rubric.condition: The output contains the literal substring "provisional": true at least once.

rubric.criterion: A non-provisional candidate is labelled false
rubric.condition: The output contains the literal substring "provisional": false at least once, so the field is never omitted for a normally-discovered candidate.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md task step 7 (Stage 0 provisional sources).
